recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7107; avoid a separate reconciliation commit for duplicate FHIR-6921.
issue_request: FHIR-7107 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Vocabulary issue for FHIR-core ValueSet. It reported that the ValueSet identifier control was 0..1, requested an unbounded max, and the accepted resolution was to describe the relationship between local id, canonical url, and external identifier with an example of use.
initial_application: The explicit application was git-svn commit b75464b94697d9b00b6b570ddd6909adbccab562, corresponding to svn revision 5715 from the Jira comment, which added a ValueSet Identification section describing ValueSet.id, ValueSet.url, and ValueSet.identifier. Later source reorganizations retained and refined that narrative, and current StructureDefinition source has ValueSet.identifier with max='*'.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml and source/valueset/valueset-introduction.xml are current build inputs. The current example ValueSet contains two identifier repetitions. FHIR-6921 is the same ValueSet request in duplicate status and was not decided separately. No relevant Zulip or Confluence record was found that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already has ValueSet.identifier as 0..*, the identification narrative distinguishes local identity, canonical URL, and external business identifiers, and the example demonstrates repeated identifiers.
